findings: Gameplay PlayCardFromHand prepares currentTarget before play notification, Gotcha early return, movement and CardPlayedFromHand: positive IDs resolve by map, zero/negative IDs assign NoObject.
Headless code previously wrote currentTarget only after counter/entry callbacks, overwriting any callback update; ordinary Gotcha and autoplay Gotcha returns did not clear stale targets.

Preparation now occurs after cost and before notification/movement in normal play and both autoplay callers. The independent caller marks its target prepared so the common body does not overwrite it again. The late assignment is removed.
The separate direct-play path is unchanged; its parsed body does not assign currentTarget and existing direct-entry tests preserve that distinction.

New56case matrix covers both sides, unit/Gotcha, stale/null initial state, normal and two autoplay callers; normal calls test null/positive/zero/negative and same-ID alias input. Movement observes the mapped target and its intentional rewrite survives.

New2case interaction uses real BARRAGE/SECRET OPERATIVES IR with the single-target choice selected and a durable controlled ground target. The counter now triggers and records its own permanent+2defense source buff.
limits: This fixes currentTarget storage timing and lookup, not every target parameter/requery elsewhere in the play/deployment/choice pipeline.
Flow proof assumes ActionProcess remains true and valid contexts/normal returns; it does not inline callbacks, model false flag paths, exceptions or native lifetime/reentry.
The matrix uses controlled definitions, aliases, zero/negative IDs and field rewrites. It is not proof those probes arise in ordinary real-card matches, nor a UObject replacement/GC test.
The two-card interaction certifies the exercised target-dependent counter path only, not complete BARRAGE or SECRET OPERATIVES semantics. Target durability is synthetic to isolate its buff.
Full action scheduling, missing source/target IDs, moving identity maps during callbacks, native packet/notification ABI and action-ID random reseeding remain open.
No historical replay authority, new game memory reads, writes or injection. Fully semantically verified cards remains0.
